about: The brawler as data (docs/brawler_data_model.md): roster (layer 1), enemies + AI presets (layer 2), stages (layer 3). tools/brawler/build_tables.py turns it into the tables the game reads (build/game_tables.c / .h, build/roster.json for the fighter export).

Sized from the explosion's smoke and flames measured in KOF98 in our emulator (/data/tmp/iori2/kof98_624d): about -36..+100 px from Iori at the release blow (he steps 16 px forward on it; the victim 36 px ahead, burning as it flies), the fury's depth

roster_benched.about: Fighters out of the roster for now (not exported, not on the select screen); their data, exporters and scenarios stay. Moving an entry back into roster (and select_layout) brings it back. Kuroko: TODO #212 (Bruno 2026-10-07: 'Remove Kuroko for now'); his select_layout entry was {x 249, y 183, z 20, facing left, pose [0, 0], slot 7}, now Cheng-Fu's place.

meter.about: the two bars (Bruno's live redesign 2026-10-08, docs/brawler_gold.md; fighter.c 'the meter'), players only (enemies pay nothing). DRIVE (shown: the HUD's two chunks): chunks x chunk points, full at the start and at a new life, one point back a frame (a chunk refills in chunk frames: 240 = 4 s); refill_pause: where the refill stops (Bruno 2026-10-09, note 20261009-115529-5d29: 'only outside of combos and activities'): 'special' = in a special (a C special, a Blitz, the breaker, a fury, a MAX), 'chain' = attacking (a chain's links, air attacks); back in neutral (idle, walk, run, jump) it refills; a C special costs `special` chunks (short of them it does not come out), a breaker (C or A+B in a hit stun or held: always the fighter's neutral C special) costs `breaker` chunks and blinks WHITE (blink frames white, as many not) for the whole move; short of them it costs life_breaker life (never the last point) and blinks RED instead. FURY GAUGE (hidden, never drawn): fury_max points, filled fury_dealt a point of damage dealt and fury_taken a point taken (the fury's own hits not counted), empty at the start, kept at a new life, emptied by the fury; full: D = the fury, full and life <= low % of the full life: D = the MAX; while full the fighter blinks 1 frame its colours / 1 frame a shiny white palette (red 1 / 1 when the MAX is ready); the life bar blinks red at low life (KOF95's 8 / 8, main.c). infinite 1: nothing spent, both full (a test switch)

special_flash.about: Bruno 2026-10-10 (note 20261010-145455-b3f3: 'every special that is triggered should make the character blink with a blue palette for a split second ... it's costing energy'): a C special paid with drive (C + the stick, the hold's C, a cancel into one, an air special on C) shows the fighter in a tinted palette for `frames` frames from its start; tint = the colour, 0-31 a channel (each channel = the colour's light x tint / 16 + tint / 4, clamped: fighter.c ovl_pal). Bruno 2026-10-10 reopen: '10 frames, completely fully blue' -> 10 frames, pure blue (no red / green left). Not the breaker (its white / red blink), not the fury / MAX (their own signals), not a free Blitz

blitz.about: the Blitz (Bruno 2026-10-08, docs/brawler_gold.md): a free, meterless move on a double direction + A: forward,forward / down,down / down,up / up,up + A (roster[].blitz ff / dd / du / uu: a special of its pool played free, not invincible, its own recovery; 'dash' = its dash attack, its tree's dash entry; absent = nothing; every fighter without a blitz entry: ff = 'dash'). window: frames allowed between the two taps and from the second tap to A (main.c read_player); run + A plays the ff slot too. chord: A+B = C, pressed on the same frame, or the second within `chord` frames of the first (fighter.c turns a prejump / a normal's first frames into the C). damage: a special played as a Blitz deals this whole damage on a full connect (its special tier scaled by damage / tiers.special)

jump.about: ONE jump for every fighter (Bruno 2026-10-08): Cody's Final Fight arc, captured frame by frame from the ROM in /data/emu (FBNeo, World 900112: /data/tmp/newsys/scripts/ff_jump.py): crouch frames on the ground, then one height (lines above the floor) a frame in the air, dx the forward jump's travel a frame in CPS1 pixels (scaled by x_scale 320 / 384 to the Neo Geo's pixels: the same distance on a TV), land_dx on the landing frame; a straight jump has no travel, a back jump the forward's mirrored. land: the landing's frames, any input ends it from land_cancel on (FF: cancellable at once). Air attacks: forward jump + A (roster[].air.forward), straight jump + A (air.straight) knock down and stay active active_min frames at least; down + A in either jump (air.down) flinches and stays active to the landing; down + A cancels into the jump's attack on hit (down_cancel 'hit'; 'any': at any time). Defaults (a fighter without roster[].air): forward atk_d_jump, straight atk_c_jump, down atk_a_jump

walk.about: walk speeds by archetype (Bruno 2026-10-08: Terry = Cody, Kim = Guy, Krauser = Haggar): Final Fight's 2.10 / 1.95 / 1.85 CPS1 px a frame x 320 / 384 = the same time to cross the screen; sub-pixel (16.16, no whole-pixel rounding); run = run x walk; the walk / run animations play at the new speed / the fighter's KOF speed (feet don't slide); anim = the walk / run animations' frame rate x this on top (Bruno 2026-10-08: 1.5, the frames switch faster, the movement speed unchanged)

depth.about: the walkable floor's back edge per background (stage.h stages[] index, tools/brawler/make_stage_ra.py): [x, z] points along the stage (world px, x rising; z = the smallest Z a fighter may have there, feet y = floor_top + z), straight lines between them, the end points' Z past them; a background without an entry: Z from 0. Players and enemies: walking, spawning, knockback, the AI's goals (fighter.c clamp, ai.c slot_goal). Read on the art: the lowest scenery pixel (wall curb, truck shadow, rubble) + 2 px. Bruno 2026-10-09 (note 20261009-102742-5d29, stage 1 wave 2, x 919): z 15 is the deepest there, else the feet step over the background pixels. Background 1 (stage 1): rubble 0-80, the wall's curb (y 163) z 8, the wall's slope + the truck's shadow (171) z 15, the scrap pile (168) z 12 with its two striped bars lying out (176 / 172) z 20 / 16, the second truck z 15, the crate and the barrier (163) z 8

tiers.about: the damage tiers (revamp phase 2, Bruno 2026-10-08: specials about equal across all characters +-15 %, furies +-20 %, MAX +-20 %, special < fury < MAX; fighter.c 'damage tiers'): the whole damage of every special / fury / MAX on a full connect (life 60; the chain totals 21 / 23 / 27: a special about half a chain, a fury one heavy chain and more, the MAX two chains); spread = the allowed band in %, the bands may not overlap; measured = each move's own total in our emulator (tools/brawler/damage_tiers.py --raw --save), each move scaled to its tier; super_throw = the super throw's whole damage (revamp 3: between the special and the fury, a stock buys it)

chain.about: the chain core (revamp 1A, docs/brawler_feel.md 8h, fighter.c 'chain core', routes.py chain_tree): one system for every fighter. A chain advances only on a hit; a whiff or being hit restarts it at link 1. window: frames after a link's recovery to press the next one; buffer: a player's press this many frames (hit-stop not counted) before the next link may start still fires, a press in the hit-stop is latched; lengths: links by roster[].archetype (Final Fight's Guy 5 / Cody 4 / Haggar 3); totals: the whole chain's damage by archetype (Final Fight 42 / 46 / 54, halved to the brawler's life of 60); hitstop: [jab, finisher] frames, link k on that scale, every finisher the last (a special's / fury's / throw's: the engine's 7); juggle_cap: air hits a juggled fighter takes, then untouchable until it lands (downed: untouchable; a fury's own hits excepted); stun_player + guard_player: a player's hit stun and its untouchable window from the hit (only the one that hit it reaches it meanwhile); stun_light / stun_heavy: an enemy's hit stun. roster[].finishers: launcher = the stick that plays the launcher (up, forward or neutral), down = sweep (a trip) or slam (a ground slam that bounces), or null; neutral / forward / up / down_move = a move name to override the generator's pick

hit_sounds.about: the hit sounds (Bruno's impact-sound picks 2026-10-09, brawler-lab/impacts.html; gamedata.h ghitsnd_t, fighter.c btn_sound): songs.json sfx names. light / strong: the hit cycles, every A / B normal's hit (a hold's, a throw's sounding as A / B) plays the attacker's next light entry, every C / D one its next strong entry (C+D and knockdowns: $15; a fighter's roster[].hit_sfx button or a route node's own sound list still wins). light = KOF94's cycle of three, table $59FA (indices $E1 $E4 $E7, pan C $1A $60 / $63 / $66), counter $46F8(a5) + 1 mod 3 on every normal hit ($594C); strong = KOF95's cycle of eight, table $5674 = indices $0C $0D $0F $0F $0D $0D $0E $0F = one-byte commands $C0 $C1 $C3 $C3 $C1 $C1 $C2 $C3, counter $5E66(a5) & 7 ($5542; KOF95 has no strong set, Bruno: 'KOF95 hit by strong (cyclic)'). Both games keep one counter for the whole game; here each attacker its own (fighter_t.hcyc). guard: the guard sound (KOF94's projectile hit; no guard yet: fighter_guard_sound, unused); boss_ko: the boss's killing hit (KOF94's KO blow), its death voice scream_delay frames later (main.c boss_ko_start / boss_ko_tick, < 300: inside the slow motion); bounce: each floor contact of the boss's death fall, its first landing and the one after its bounce (KOF94's KO landing, index $227: $66EA plays it in place of the body landing when the fallen body has no life, on both contacts $8C7C / $8D00; feedback 20261009-223719-b3f3; main.c boss_ko_start sets fighter_t.kthud, fighter.c floor_thud)

super_flash.about: fx.super_flash (TODO #139, Bruno 2026-10-06: an engine rule, no per-move data but an optional anchor): every fury (D) and MAX fury (down+D) of every fighter. From the fury's frame start the game freezes except the attacker for freeze frames (enemies, projectiles, the camera, waves and timers, other players; only the attacker's own boxes hit: Kim's Phoenix hits inside the flash, KOF's furies 39-47 frames in, after it), the stage is hidden and the backdrop is white_colour for white frames, then dark_colour; KOF98's concentration plays at the anchor (the move's own, read from its KOF animation, else this one: px from the feet, KOF orientation, negative x = forward), blue for a fury, orange for a MAX fury. Values: KOF98's (tools/kof96/handlers98.md 'Super flash': the flash effect's animation + 1 = 28 frames, its white event step + 1 = 4). sound (Bruno 2026-10-06, the fury charge): the effect played at the flash start, KOF98's own: the flash routine $370F0 / $373FC sends sound index $99 = $1A $3A for every DM and SDM alike (measured in our emulator: Terry, Ryo, Ralf, Kyo, DM and MAX, the same command on the flash frame); must be in songs.json sfx. sound_max (TODO #155, Bruno 2026-10-06: KOF2000's MAX sound, the high whistle): played instead of sound when the fury is the MAX (down+D): KOF2000's SDM flash effect, $1E $8F there (measured in our emulator: K' and Terry, every DM flash $1E $BC, every SDM flash $1E $8F), the brawler $1A $8F (songs.json sfx from)

rules.about: Every enemy's shared rules (revamp 1B, docs/brawler_data_model.md 'Enemy rules', ai.c): attack tokens, the ready pose during the random wait, wind-up by damage, the hidden difficulty rank.

geese_intro.speaker: GEESE
lines: So you made it this far.

ending.about: The ending (Bruno 2026-10-11, decisions open-2026-10-11 card ending-music): after the last stage's boss and the win poses, main.c's ending screens in this order: story (the winner's big portrait, else his win pose + HUD face, his story typed in a box that scrolls; music = music), staff (the credits scrolling up a pixel at a time, a line (8 px) every `step` ticks: sprites drawn by tools/brawler/staff_roll.py in the S ROM font; music = staff_music), thanks (the winner in his win pose; the staff song fades out, $0A + fade), then BOSS UNLOCKED when the boss was beaten for the first time, then back to the BIOS (title / attract). Each screen: START (or A-D) goes on after `min` ticks; story: `type` ticks a character, `hold` ticks once typed; staff: `hold` ticks once the last line is up; thanks: `time` ticks. story.fighters: per roster fighter (by name) 4-5 sentences, '*' = any other; build_tables.py wraps them to 34 columns. staff.lines: a string a line, '^' = a heading (highlighted), centred, at most 34 characters.

*: The last enemy falls, and the city goes quiet.
The winner stands alone under the morning sun.
The bosses of the underworld are gone.
Word of this fight spreads far and wide.
A new legend has been born.
terry: Goenitz falls, and the wind over the city goes still.
Terry tips his cap and walks away without a word.
Rock is waiting for him back in South Town.
The Lone Wolf has a promise to keep.
Okay! It is time to go home.
ryo: The last of the bosses lies at Ryo's feet.
He bows, as his father Takuma taught him.
At the Kyokugen dojo, the students cheer the news.
Robert pays for the party, as always.
At dawn, the Invincible Dragon is back in training.
ralf: Ralf radios Commander Heidern with the good news.
Clark already has the helicopter warmed up.
The Ikari Warriors leave before the police arrive.
New orders are waiting for them in the desert.
robert: Robert Garcia smiles for the cameras.
His father's company will rebuild every street that burned.
Yuri calls to say that Ryo is jealous.
Robert laughs and books the best table in town.
The Raging Tiger always wins in style.
yamazaki: Ryuji Yamazaki counts the money he took from the bosses.
South Town's underworld has a new king.
Nobody dares to look him in the eye.
But the Orochi blood in his veins will not keep quiet.
He laughs, and the night laughs with him.
billy: Billy Kane looks up at the empty Geese Tower.
For the first time in years, he answers to no one.
He sends a postcard to his sister Lilly in England.
Then he spins his staff and walks into the rain.
South Town will hear from him again.
kyo: The fight is over, and Kyo Kusanagi yawns.
He has missed another exam at school.
Yuki is waiting at the gate with her arms crossed.
Somewhere in the dark, Iori is already hunting him.
iori: Iori Yagami stands alone among the ruins.
The moon is red, and his blood is howling.
He does not spare a glance for the fallen.
Only one name is on his mind: Kyo Kusanagi.
mai: Mai Shiranui bows with her fan held high.
The Shiranui ninja arts have proven themselves again.
Now she wants her reward: a wedding with Andy.
But Andy has already left to train in the mountains.
Mai runs after him, shouting his name.
yashiro: Yashiro Nanakase cracks his neck and laughs.
Nobody in this city was strong enough to stop him.
Tonight his band plays to a packed house.
But deep below, Orochi stirs in its sleep.
One of the Heavenly Kings is awake.
geese: Geese Howard looks down from the top of his tower.
Every rival who dared to challenge him is broken.
South Town belongs to him once more.
He pours a glass of wine and smiles at the night.
mr_big: Mr. Big counts the money from his new clubs.
Every gang in the city now pays him tribute.
His sticks spin faster than ever.
Only Takuma and his Kyokugen fools still stand.
Next time, he swears, they will fall too.
krauser: Wolfgang Krauser returns to his castle in Germany.
To him, this fight was a fine game and nothing more.
His orchestra plays a requiem in his honour.
He has not forgotten his half-brother Geese.
The Emperor awaits a worthy rival.
k_dash: K' pulls his glove tight and turns his back.
NESTS made him a weapon, but he fights for himself.
Maxima is waiting with the engine running.
K' says nothing on the long drive.
rugal: Rugal Bernstein laughs on the deck of his carrier.
Another army of fighters has fallen before him.
Their statues will join his gallery tonight.
The power of Orochi still burns in his eye.
The King of Fighters is Rugal alone.
goenitz: The storm dies down, and Goenitz folds his hands.
The humans fought well, but no one stops the wind.
He returns to his quiet church to pray.
Orochi will awaken soon, as it was written.
Heaven's wind blows in his favour.
haohmaru: Haohmaru drinks sake under the cherry blossoms.
His sword rests at his side, its work done.
Genjuro is still out there, and their duel waits.
There is always a stronger opponent somewhere.
At dawn, he takes the road again.
genjuro: Genjuro Kibagami wipes his blade clean.
He fought for no one but himself.
The gambling dens will talk of nothing else.
But Haohmaru still lives, and that will not do.
Genjuro walks into the night, a card in his hand.
cheng_fu: Cheng Fu bows to his fallen opponents.
His kung fu was tested in the streets and held.
He returns to his small school in the old town.
His students listen to the tale with wide eyes.
hanzo: Hattori Hanzo vanishes in a puff of smoke.
The honour of the Iga clan is restored.
Fuuma will say he could have done it faster.
Hanzo does not bother to answer him.
The time machine carries him back to his era.
hanzo_ss2: Hattori Hanzo sheathes his blade in silence.
The shogun will hear of this victory tonight.
At home, his son Shinzo waits for him.
The Iga ninja serve from the shadows.
Hanzo is gone before the dust settles.
kim: Kim Sue Il lowers his leg and bows.
His taekwondo has broken every gang in the city.
Justice, he says, must always win.
He promises to keep watch over these streets.
rosa: Rosa brushes the dust from her coat.
The men who ran this city are on the ground.
She does not stay to hear the crowd.
There is another score to settle far away.
Rosa walks off without looking back.
billy_lee: Billy Lee wipes the blood from his lip.
The gang that ruled the city is broken.
Jimmy shows up late, as always.
The Lee brothers ride home together.
The Sosetsuken has kept the city safe again.
